newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Elscint sells scanner to Jordan.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Elscint sells scanner to Jordan.

text.p: Israel's Elscint Ltd said on Monday it had won a Jordanian government tender to supply a hospital in Amman with an MRI medical scanner.
The company said the $1.5 million deal marked the first time it had won a tender of this scope in a neighbouring country.

"The effort to achieve a first sale in Jordan has importance beyond the economic realm. Elscint sees this step as building a bridge of cooperation between the two countries," the company said in a statement.

It said Elscint, which produces a range of computer-based medical-imaging diagnostic systems, had entered several Jordanian government tenders since Israel signed a peace agreement with the country in 1994.
The company said it would deliver the scanner to the Al-Bashir hospital in Amman in a few months.
